description: The visual treatment of the TmAppShell frame: how the page content sits on the shell's workspace background.

members.name: Inset
members.description: The content is a rounded card floating on the workspace background (the default): the frame reads as one surface with a gutter around it, like a desktop application window.

members.name: Flat
members.description: The content fills the frame edge to edge, separated from the navigation by a hairline border only. The denser treatment for data-heavy applications.
